name: Tracker text
trigger: RAID log, Jira or ServiceNow text owed

steps.name: Draft text
steps.means: The client agent writes the text for the tracker (Jira, ServiceNow, CVC).

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the text against its checklist.

steps.name: Paste
steps.means: Ben pastes it into the tracker; nothing posts on its own. That closes the case.
steps.gate: Ben pastes; nothing posts in code
